mapper.select: SELECT source_message_id, delivery_generation, owner_type, owner_id, state, published_message_id FROM sq_final_delivery WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY delivery_generation DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_final_delivery ( delivery_id, user_id, source_message_id, delivery_generation, owner_type, owner_id, state, creator_id, last_updater_id ) VALUES ( #{deliveryId}, #{userId}, #{messageId}, #{generation}, 'RESPONSE', #{executionId}, 'OWNED', #{userId}, #{userId} )
